Maria Chen: Final RN snippet below. Midnight UTC change window. Need ops + compliance ack and a named rollback owner.

Kevin Liu: reading. any model pins?

Maria Chen: yes: primary rev-2026-03-20, fallback rev-2026-03-08. Also a small streaming buffer fix and an additive embedding field `embedding_metadata.version`.

Sasha Ortiz: embedding field is backwards compatible. I'll ping SDK leads for v0.9.2 microcopy.

Jamal Reed: rollback triggers: auto-abort if overall error-rate > 2.5% or embedding invalids > 4% on smoke set. Manual rollback if p99 latency +15% sustained 5m, or any dedicated OOMs.

Maria Chen: agreed. DeployBot schedule please: 10% canary at 00:00 UTC, pause at 00:30 UTC for manual sign-off.

DeployBot: scheduled -> 10% @00:00 UTC; hold @00:30 UTC. Link: https://deployboard.internal/canary/1799999999 Reaction: :rocket:

Sasha Ortiz: QA will run `./tools/smoke --canary=10` before the hold. If >3 failures, we halt.

Kevin Liu: ops note: dashboards pinned (streaming-latency, embed-validations, gpu-metrics). I'll be monitoring.

DeployBot: canary snapshot posted: https://deployboard.internal/canary/1799999999/metrics - error-rate 0.8%, embed-invalid 1.1%, p99 +3% vs baseline. Reaction: :white_check_mark:

Sasha Ortiz: smoke run result: 0 failed / 100 after transient retry.

Jamal Reed: rollback executor nominated: Kevin. If we exceed thresholds I'll run `deploybot rollback --to=rev-2026-03-08`.

ComplianceBot: compliance copy included for EU customers. Approved.

Maria Chen: internal announcement copy (for #all-hands):

```
Heads-up: rolling deployment tonight at 00:00 UTC (10% canary). Changes: minor streaming fix, pinned model revisions for stability, and an additive embedding metadata field. Expected progression: 10% -> hold at 00:30 UTC -> full rollout if checks pass.
```

Kevin Liu: fine.

Sasha Ortiz: ready to monitor SDK alerts.

Maria Chen: posting RN to #all-hands T-2h and proceeding with DeployBot schedule unless objections.

Kevin Liu: no objections.

DeployBot: standing by for `deploybot promote` at 00:30 UTC or `deploybot rollback` if thresholds breached.

Maria Chen: thanks all. Reaction: :tada:
